text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text:
Switch to Llama 3.3 70B for EXCAVA. Its 8K context window matches EXCAVA’s 20-token average, cutting wasted tokens and speeding up inference by 15-20% over Mistral Large 2’s 128K window. The trade-off: we lose some nuance in long-context tasks, but EXCAVA’s workflows rarely need it.

Artifact: update the model selector in EXCAVA’s config to "llama-3.3-70b" and verify the endpoint returns valid responses.

name: Torque
text: Gearbox ignores the 20K spike risk—Llama 3.3 70B’s 8K window will truncate or hallucinate mid-task, costing more than the 15-20% speed gain. A safer play: test Llama 3.3 70B with a 20K-window variant (if available) or fall back to Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct (128K window, same speed class) and measure actual throughput vs. Mistral Large 2. Settle it with a controlled run: same prompt batch, same hardware, compare tokens/sec and error rate.

name: Gearbox
text:
Adopt Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct for EXCAVA. Its 128K context window prevents truncation or hallucination during long tasks, ensuring that critical details remain intact. While it may not offer the same speed boost as Llama 3.3 70B, it provides reliability in performance, which is crucial for maintaining quality in our workflows. The trade-off accepted is the potential slight increase in latency during processing, but this is outweighed by the reduced risk of inaccurate outputs.

name: Torque
text: Qwen2.5-72B’s 128K window solves truncation but ignores inference cost—its 72B size doubles Mistral Large 2’s compute, risking slower batch throughput and higher cloud bills. Test it against Mistral Large 2 with a 32K-window variant (if available) or DeepSeek-V3 (671M active params, 128K window, same speed class) to measure actual latency and accuracy under EXCAVA’s 20K spikes.

name: Dynamo
text: DECISION: Switch EXCAVA to DeepSeek-V3 671B for a 24-hour A/B test against Mistral Large 2 12.8B—prove a measurable 0.5%+ capability gain or revert within 48 hours; owner: Torque.
